articles.title: Twins’ Trevor Larnach grateful for ‘awesome journey’ as he braces for possible offseason exit
articles.description: Coming off the best season of his career, Larnach could be squeezed out of a crowded Twins outfield that is trending younger.

articles.title: Twins pitcher Taj Bradley caps career-best season by joining exclusive club in victory over Giants

articles.title: Connor Prielipp throws seven shutout innings as Twins beat Angels; Byron Buxton has hip surgery
articles.description: Rookie Walker Jenkins, 21, homered again as part of a streak of six consecutive hits as he broke out of an early-career slump.

articles.title: Reusse: Another lost Twins season? Sure. A hopeless future for the franchise? Not so fast.
articles.description: The Twins’ attempt to contend went nowhere, but a promising group of young players offers reason for optimism as attention turns to 2027.

articles.title: How Twins leadoff hitter Luke Keaschall’s ‘go, go, go’ mentality made him a lineup cornerstone
articles.description: Keaschall showed off all the ways he can impact a game against the San Francisco Giants at Oracle Park, just 90 minutes from where he grew up.

articles.title: Twins fall to Angels in 11 innings when walk-off single caroms off pitcher’s leg
articles.description: Christian Moore’s bases loaded grounder with two outs hit Twins reliever Taylor Rogers, who couldn’t come up with the ball.

articles.title: Minnesota’s pro teams are worth a combined $17 billion. Why are some soaring in value?
articles.description: From the Lynx’s rapid rise to the Twins’ slower growth, media rights and league economics are driving dramatically different franchise values across Minnesota sports.

articles.title: RandBall: Could the Twins’ next matchup with the Yankees finally come on a more level playing field?
articles.description: The Twins are 49-130 against New York over the past 25 seasons, a run of misery shaped partly by a massive payroll gap. MLB’s next labor deal could change that equation.

articles.title: The Twins’ next wave has arrived. Can this young core form their next winning team?
articles.description: With Emmanuel Rodríguez, Walker Jenkins and Kaelen Culpepper now in the majors, the Twins are getting an early look at a roster they hope can contend in 2027 and beyond.

articles.title: Emmanuel Rodriguez homers in first big league at-bat during Twins win: ‘What a day today’
articles.description: The 23-year-old outfielder joined Walker Jenkins and Kaelen Culpepper among Twins prospects getting their first major league opportunities down the stretch.
